activity.notes: Trimble served as First Minister after devolution took effect in December 1999 until his resignation took effect on 1 July 2001. ATLAS splits this from his later return rather than creating a false continuous 1999-2002 term.

sources.title: Northern Ireland Assembly Chronology
sources.citation_text: The Northern Ireland Assembly chronology records Trimble's First Ministership under devolution and his resignation taking effect on 1 July 2001.
